NBA DFS Picks for Sunday, November 22 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 5 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 5:21 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Sunday, November 22 DraftKings main slate at 63.9 DraftKings points for $12,200. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.8, $10,100) and Franz Wagner (ORL, 48.5, $9,700) are next.

Buddy Hield (CHI) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.21 projected points per $1,000 at $3,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 5:21 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
